_meta.title: Decision package: high-traffic experimental SaaS demo LP
_meta.why_strong_example: Demonstrates allowance of 1 super test for direction-finding when traffic supports it. 4 plans → 3 ship (1 super + 2 basic in parallel) + 0 iterate + 1 kill. Strategic recommendation points operator toward holding next-batch budget until super test verdict.

prior_tests_tried: Hero CTA copy variants (Book demo / Get started / See it work) — Get started won by 8%
input_summary.page_works_summary: baseline=works (good for B2B SaaS demo); trust anatomy 50% load on logo wall + product screenshot + case study; preservation_zones include hero screenshot + customer logos.

shipped_plans.why_this_first: Super test: replace 'Book a demo' funnel with 'Start free trial' for self-serve segment. High traffic supports clean signal at the operator's expected_lift_floor of 10%. If wins, fundamentally changes program direction; if loses, validates current paradigm. Either way, biggest single learning available.

Basic test on product screenshot variant — different feature highlighted (collaboration vs speed vs AI integrations). Page-Works flagged screenshot as 20% load — testing variants is preservation-aware (we keep screenshot, vary content).
Basic test parallel-safe with T2 (different page element). Reorder logo wall to lead with most ICP-relevant brands by visitor segment. Preservation-aware (keep logos, vary order).

killed_plans.kill_reason: Plan adds 'Limited demo slots — book today' urgency banner. Page-Works specifically warned: 'DO NOT add aggressive urgency mechanisms. Falsely manufactured urgency erodes B2B trust catastrophically.' Plan violates documented anti-pattern; high downside risk; no traffic to recover from a brand-trust erosion event.

decision.strategic_recommendation: This batch's super test (T1: paradigm shift to free-trial funnel) is the highest-leverage decision in the program. Recommend operator HOLD next-batch traffic budget until T1 verdict — if it wins, the program pivots to PLG optimization; if it loses, current sales-led paradigm is validated and program continues with incremental optimization. T2 + T3 in parallel will inform creative direction either way.
constraint_warnings: Operator has experimental risk_appetite — allowed 1 super test in batch. Without that appetite signal, T1 would be deferred.
Prior CTA-copy test result is incorporated: T1's variant CTA uses 'Get started' (the prior winner) for the trial flow.
expert_conflicts_resolved: Hypothesis Generator's T4 plan had high ICE (urgency banners often lift in non-B2B niches). Page-Works flagged it as preservation_zone_violation. Director sided with Page-Works — B2B SaaS audience is uniquely sensitive to manufactured urgency.
decision.next_batch_focus: Wait for T1 super-test result first. If T1 wins (paradigm shift to trial): next batch focuses on trial-funnel optimization (onboarding, activation milestones). If T1 loses (sales-led wins): next batch focuses on demo-form qualification + sales-handoff optimization.
